<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="13" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="18" x2="331" y2="11" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="18" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="19" x2="353" y2="19" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="361" y="9" width="22" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="11" width="16" height="7" rx="1.3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="32,66 25,73 32,80" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="73" x2="47" y2="73" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="77" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Mint</text>
    <circle cx="218" cy="70" r="4" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="97" x2="390" y2="97" stroke="#F1F1F1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="124" width="342" height="190" rx="20" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="177" r="38" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <rect x="174" y="174" width="42" height="29" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="176,178 195,191 214,178" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="207" cy="163" r="11" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="202,163 206,167 213,158" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Forgot your password?</text>
    <text x="195" y="274" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">No worries — we’ll help you get back in.</text>
    <text x="195" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Enter your email to receive a reset code.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="357" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Email adress</text>
    <rect x="24" y="370" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="399" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="40,398 48,404 56,398" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="69" y="405" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">you@example.com</text>
    <text x="24" y="452" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Use the email address connected to your Mint account.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="478" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="476" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="513" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SEND CODE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Support card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="565" width="342" height="86" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="24" y="563" width="342" height="86" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="594" r="16" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="590" r="4" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <ellipse cx="53" cy="601" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <text x="80" y="590" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Need a little help?</text>
    <text x="80" y="613" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Check your inbox and spam folder</text>
    <text x="80" y="631" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">for the reset email.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Return link -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="702" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Remember your password?</text>
    <text x="195" y="728" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Return to Log in</text>
    <line x1="132" y1="733" x2="258" y2="733" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,793 49,784 59,793" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="42" y="792" width="14" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="126" cy="794" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="132" y1="800" x2="138" y2="806" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="126" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Add -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="795" r="17" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <line x1="188" y1="795" x2="202" y2="795" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="195" y1="788" x2="195" y2="802" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="195" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Create</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Notifications -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="264" cy="786" r="3" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <rect x="256" y="790" width="16" height="13" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="270" cy="789" r="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <text x="264" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Alerts</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="341" cy="789" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="341" cy="801" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="341" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
